1. In the frozen text sources/civilization-thought-v1.0/evidence/texts/YWH-Q.txt, line 47 has the sentence 「故「靡不有初，鮮克有終」」 inside the 〈…〉 that follows 「知終終之，可與存義也」 in 乾·文言. That bracket is 王弼's 注. Line 48 is 孔疏, and it only restates the 注 (「「故靡不有初，鮮克有終」者，見利則行…」).

It pins the 注 to 「知終終之」, since the 注 comments on the 文言 sentence about 九三 and not on 九三's 爻辞. It drops the 〔YWH-Q〕 tag, because no other entry in this list carries one.
